$comment: Programs of the bundle that the per-machine installer must not stop (family ADR 0053 section 2.1); each needs a reason.

stopExclusions.reason: The service runs from its own protected folder, Dyno Helper in Program Files; a dyno-helper.exe running from the install folder is an elevated install or removal of a few seconds that must not be cut short, so the last Restart Manager listing reports it instead.
